description: This Java class provides helper methods for handling autofill functionality in an Android app, such as displaying messages and extracting autofillable fields from assist structures during autofill requests.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to display messages and extract autofill fields from assist structures for autofill service integration.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a Toast message and logs the info.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields
methods.description: Retrieves a map of autofillable fields (by hint) from a FillRequest.

methods.name: getLatestAssistStructure
methods.description: Gets the latest AssistStructure from the fill request's fill contexts.

methods.name: getAutofillableFields
methods.description: Parses the AssistStructure to identify autofillable fields and their IDs, returning a map.

methods.name: addAutofillableFields
methods.description: Recursively traverses AssistStructure ViewNodes to identify autofillable fields and adds them to the map.
